title: WPMB/731/2001 of SARITA SHARMA Vs STATE

paras.text:
Criminal Writ Petition No. 731 of 2001
Sarita Sharam ........... Petitioner
 Versus
State of Uttaranchal
and others ......... Respondents
........
Hon.A.A.Desai,C.J.
Hon.P.C.Verma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and
learned A.G.A.
The petitioner against whom the F.I.R. is lodged
U/Ss 419,420,467,468,471,504 and 506,I.P.C. claims to be
a bonafide purchaser from one Mr. Mangat Ram. According
to Mr. Arvind Vashistha, learned counsel for the petitioner,
the petitioner made a bonafide inquiry before entering
into the transaction in question. However, undisputedly
according to him, the land in question which is subject
matter of sale deed is jointly held by Mr. Mangat Ram and
his brother, who is complainant. As regards, the bonafide
inquiry he can render detailed account in investigation.
The petitioner could not make any prime facie case to
warrant interference with the F.I.R. as alleged.
We, therefore, dismiss the petition.
(P.C.Verma,J.) (A.A.Desai,C.J.)
Dt. 14.8.2001
 A
